title: Data of a normalized ordinary etale tower Brown adjunction
statement: For schemes X and Y, a morphism f and a compactification c [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], a commutative ring O, element t and supplied StrictEtaleCompactSupport S [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], define EtaleTowerBrownSiteProperties to assert Grothendieck abelianness, ordinary and derived coproducts, termwise representation of derived coproducts, and coproduct preservation and joint isomorphism detection by evaluations. Define EtaleTowerBrownAdjunction S to comprise these properties at X, the compactification middle scheme and Y; the open restriction comparison fixed by its inverse-image mate; the compact-support quotient-transition equation; additive, shift, exact, coproduct and O-scalar structures on compact support; a supplied ordinary derived right adjoint with its actual adjunction, additive, shift and exact structures; and the scalar-transpose, right-linearity, linearity and additivity equations for its Hom bijections. This is a definition of adjunction data, without asserting their existence.
